base_style.title: Animated series
base_style.text: Animated series look: clean bold black ink outlines of even weight, flat saturated cel colour with a single hard-edged shadow tone, simple graphic shapes, large expressive eyes and readable eyebrows, lively faces full of personality, slightly stylised proportions, crisp characters against soft muted backgrounds, clear readable faces and hands.
